A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 22-page versions of the same CLiFT study. Their text, equations, tables, figures and appendices can be reliably matched despite rearrangement.

before.justification: v1 reports original novel-view synthesis experiments on RealEstate10K and DL3DV, including component ablations, rendering speed–quality measurements and qualitative results.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experiments and adds a quantitative comparison of patch-wise grouping against latent K-means in Table 1.

M1.justification: The encoder, latent K-means selection, condenser, renderer, losses and two-stage training remain unchanged. Appendix Algorithm 1 retains the same token-selection procedure. Patch-wise grouping appears only as an added comparator.

E1.justification: Both versions use RealEstate10K and DL3DV for novel-view synthesis, retaining the large-scene and compression scenarios. The added grouping comparison and clustering examples do not introduce a new dataset, domain or task requirement.

E2.justification: v3 Table 1 adds patch-wise grouping, with and without the condenser, as a comparator to latent K-means. The existing random-selection ablation and the main LVSM-ED, DepthSplat and MVSplat comparisons remain.

E3.justification: The stated preprocessing, input-view counts, model sizes, training schedules, metrics and 92-scene/50-scene evaluation settings are retained. The added comparison uses 256- and 1024-token budgets already represented in Figure 3; no distinct split, training budget or testing protocol is specified.

E4.justification: Section 4.3 adds a targeted ablation testing adaptive latent clustering against uniform local patch grouping at two token budgets, with and without condensation. Figure 5 adds two clustering examples. Existing component ablations, rendering-budget analysis, failure cases and appendix visualizations remain.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests for these experiments. The added table continues the existing point-estimate reporting practice.

E6.justification: v3 Table 1 newly reports patch-wise PSNR of 22.64/27.48 at 256/1024 tokens, increasing to 22.97/27.55 with condensation. The corresponding K-means-with-condenser scores are 25.21/28.41. Existing benchmark curves and the rendering-budget results in v1 Table 1, now v3 Table 2, retain their values.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(4) and the mathematical content of Algorithm 1 are unchanged. Replacing 'half-rays' with 'rays' does not change the stated geometric formulation. No theorem, proof or substantive derivation is added or removed.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions: compressed ray-associated tokens, variable representation size and compute-adaptive rendering with storage–quality–speed trade-offs. The new ablation supports these existing claims without redefining their scope.

C2.justification: New discussion attributes K-means' advantage over patch-wise grouping to allocating capacity to informative regions. Conversely, v1 Appendix A.1 explicitly acknowledges DepthSplat's better DL3DV SSIM/LPIPS at large storage sizes; v3 drops this qualification while retaining the plots showing it. The stated failure conditions remain unchanged.

D1.justification: The printed project-page address for code and demos changes from c-lift.github.io to clift-nvs.github.io. Architecture details, hyperparameters, hardware, training times, K-means implementations and token-selection pseudocode otherwise remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The same 37 references and substantive related-work discussion are retained. Positioning relative to light-field imaging, compressive sensing and reconstruction-based or reconstruction-free rendering does not change.

P1.justification: There are limited caption clarifications, terminology edits, conference-header and acknowledgment updates, and reorganization of Appendix A after its quantitative plots move into the main text. The overall section sequence and most prose remain unchanged.

P2.justification: v3 combines v1 Figures 2, 7 and 8 into a six-panel main Figure 2, adds the small ablation Table 1 and expands Figure 5. Existing displays are repositioned or renumbered, with caption and labeling adjustments; the appendix rendering grids retain their content.

improvement.justification: The new patch-wise grouping control strengthens the evidence for latent K-means beyond v1's random-selection ablation. Consolidating all three quality metrics in Figure 2 also makes comparison easier. Removing the explicit DepthSplat qualification slightly weakens the discussion's balance, but the relevant plots remain visible; the overall benefit is limited and positive.
